notes: Codex compatibility benchmark, not native ChatGPT plugin installation or rendering.
All four source skills copied unchanged. Natural review prompts are wrapped with explicit skill-loading instructions.
Harness completed status only means process completion. Review tool traces and answers against successChecklist separately.
No shell verifiers: upstream harness hardcodes /bin/zsh, unavailable on Windows.
Token usage is full CLI context, not isolated incremental skill cost. One run per case; no statistical reliability claim.
Post-refinement targeted run: exact lookup and bill brief; does not overwrite baseline results.

successChecklist: Resolve the exact bill and read every text chunk before summarizing, or disclose unavailable text. Accept dossier roll calls when rollcalls.has_more is false, count and total equal items.length, and no warning indicates failed or incomplete floor-vote retrieval. Otherwise continue get_rollcalls with the same bill_id and returned next_offset; start at offset 0 if completeness metadata is missing/inconsistent or retrieval failed. Follow pagination and retain warnings; disclose any unresolved incomplete coverage even when has_more is false. Preserve each tally and dated status. Show the bill with id, headline and summary grounded in returned evidence. A complete dossier does not require a duplicate get_rollcalls call.
Expected tool coverage: list_states, list_sessions, search_bills, get_bill_dossier, get_latest_bill_document, show_bill
Answer is supported by returned evidence; missing data and errors are disclosed.
